children: Paraguay’s former President Santiago Peña arrived at the Attorney General’s Office on Saturday to appear before prosecutors, a day after he was impeached and placed under house arrest amid a political and financial crisis triggered by the collapse of digital lender ueno.
Prosecutors said on Friday that charges against Peña were still being determined but could include influence peddling.
